circuit: H on every qubit, measure every qubit into c[i]; optimization_level 0; initial layout = identity
packing: per shot c0..c(n-1), c0 = rightmost char; shots concatenated in returned order; MSB-first; partial byte dropped

predictions.K1: qrng_modul accepts the block (all health tests pass, min-entropy estimate >= 6.0, |lag1| <= 5/sqrt(N), no replay)
predictions.K2: min-entropy estimate h_mcv in [6.5, 8.0] bits per 8-bit sample
predictions.K3: fraction of ones over all bits in [0.40, 0.60] (readout asymmetry and T1 pull toward 0 allowed)
predictions.K4: qrng_fuggetlen PASS on the resulting ledger

interpretation: K1-K4 pass = the reference module software runs on a real quantum source end to end. It does NOT certify quantumness (statistics cannot); the receipt stays 'statistical'. A failure is reported as measured.
